discrepancies: The October 14 revision headers say the first Europe/Asia window began at 03:30 PDT / 12:30 CEST, while a residual footnote says 04:00 PDT / 13:00 CEST. Products separately says Europe began at 12:30 CEST with one additional round. Preserve the conflict rather than selecting a value.

The October 20 revision shortens Asia's morning window on October 21 and 28 to 20:00-23:00 PDT / 05:00-08:00 CEST and says the first Europe/Asia round after October 21 maintenance began at 05:00 PDT / 14:00 CEST. These are one-off historical exceptions, not a new regular schedule.

Daily European columns reuse CEST/CET clock times although CET and CEST have different UTC offsets. Q&A South America says CEST; Products says CEST/CET. Show as published, anchored to PDT, not as a verified CET conversion.
November reward-ticket expiry says CEST in Q&A versus CET in Products. Use the Products date with the discrepancy disclosed.
The October 26 hold notice gives no technical cause or reopening time. Do not infer either from the earlier transfer windows.
reviewedFacts: Global server transfers are on hold from the October 26 notice until further notice while NC investigates an issue; no reopening time is published
